channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 8 Sep: Harare light drizzle · high 22° / low 13°
item.description: Harare: high 22°, low 13° (light drizzle) · Bulawayo: high 20°, low 13° (overcast) · Mutare: high 19°, low 13° (light drizzle) · Gweru: high 19°, low 13° (light drizzle) · Masvingo: high 17°, low 14° (light drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 29°, low 19° (partly cloudy) Tsumo yezuva: Kutsva kwendebvu varume vanodzimurana. (When a beard catches fire, men help each other put it out.) #Zimbabwe #Weather #ZimbabweWeather #ZimbabweNews
